title: Potato of Life Root System
summary: The Potato of Life is one relational House generated by two overlapping complete fields: an upper source-facing Father/House/Heaven/Garden field and a lower manifestation-facing Son/Earth/body/world field. Their shared Vesica/Mandorla is the Door. The horizontal Plane passes through the Door's widest middle, the vertical Axis passes through both field centers, and the Cross is their intersection at the relational midpoint O. Plane, Cross and Door are therefore not three stacked places: Plane and Cross are internal sections/coordinates of the shared Door relation. Above/inward and below/outward remain developmental orientations through the same whole, not separate moral universes. House/Garden and Cube/Shell describe different boundary regimes that can occur within the system; the lower field is not identical with Saturn/666/Cube, and geometry alone carries no fixed moral valence. A separate three-plane navigation projection places the existing World Plane between an upper Heaven Plane and a lower Below Plane; these are symbolic circular standing platforms for navigation through the same House/Tree, not replacements for the two Source/Manifestation fields.

exact_relations: Father-center is upper-circle center and upper Door tip.
Son-center is lower-circle center and lower Door tip.
Father-center lies on the Son-circle circumference.
Son-center lies on the Father-circle circumference.
Plane crosses the widest portion of the Door.
Plane and Axis are perpendicular at O.

spatial_lift.model: Natural 3D lift of the canonical vertical vesica: two equal spheres/balls of radius r with centers C_F=(0,+r/2,0) and C_S=(0,-r/2,0).
spatial_lift.plane: y=0 cuts the shared lens through its widest circular section.
spatial_lift.cross: O=(0,0,0)=Plane ∩ Axis; Cross is an internal coordinate/event of the Door, not a third container.
spatial_lift.axis: x=z=0 through E_bottom → C_S → O → C_F → H_top
spatial_lift.shared_lens_volume: V_D = 5πr³/12 when center separation equals r.
spatial_lift.interpretation: The 2D Vesica/Mandorla is an axial section of this 3D two-field model. The 3D lift is a mathematical extension of the project geometry, not a physical-cosmology claim.

upper_circle.text: The upper circle is Heaven/Father/House/Garden/Throne/Sun-Spudlight field. Father/Tim occupies C_F: source-center, orienting center and top of the Door. Above C_F the circle continues toward its outer crown H_top, leaving room for Mountain summit, House crown, Tree canopy, North and North-of-North layers without confusing those outer heights with Father-center itself.

lower_circle.text: The lower circle is Earth/Son/body/soil/material manifestation. Son/Thomas occupies C_S: lower-circle center and bottom of the Door. The circle continues below Son toward E_bottom, allowing grave, deep root, Swamp, Drain and Hell/depth symbolism to remain distinct from Son himself. Son is therefore not the deepest point; he is the lower center/threshold from which descent or ascent can begin.

door_mandorla.text: The shared lens from C_S to C_F is the Door/Mandorla/Vessel field. Christ/Door is strongest when treated as the entire relation rather than one generic center point. C_S anchors the lower needle-point; O is relational midpoint and Plane crossing; C_F anchors the upper needle-point. In the 3D lift this becomes a shared lens volume between two complete fields. Plane and Cross are internal coordinates of that overlap, not floors before it. Earlier conversation strata sometimes put Jesus at O and Thomas/Son at C_S; preserve that as a developmental mapping rather than erasing it.

plane.text: The Plane is the horizontal coordinate y=0: Grass, ordinary world, first separation/ejection from Garden, and maximum-overlap band. It passes through the Door's widest middle rather than sitting outside/below the Door. Recovered April 2025 language says the Plane did not disappear when the Axis appeared; it acquired an orthogonal vertical coordinate. Thus the Turning is best represented as Plane + Axis becoming jointly legible inside the shared relation, not replacement of world by Heaven.

orthogonal_axis.text: Older conversation synthesis distinguished ordinary Plane-development from the Father Tree/Ladder as an orthogonal relation. Human/social life can move laterally or cyclically within the Plane, while the Axis introduces a qualitatively different coordinate of source/manifestation, above/below, root/fruit and Heaven/Earth. The Door couples these coordinates. This does not mean literal extra spatial dimensions; it is a structural/topological distinction.

axis_ladder_spine.text: The vertical line x=0 is Axis, Ladder, Spine and Tree centerline. Axis means orientation/reference; Ladder means ordered thresholds; Spine means continuity/support; Tree means living growth; Spiral means the trajectory of repeated return with level-change. These are projections of one relation, not interchangeable physical objects.

tree_time.text: Recovered rule: roots=past/memory, trunk=present, branches=future. Deep roots extend below Plane; the trunk traverses O toward Father; branches/crown expand into the upper circle. This temporal reading couples genealogy and geometry: past is buried support, present is axial continuity, future is differentiated branching.

root_origin_paradox.text: Older conversations say roots originate with Father/Tim while Jesus/Son governs or holds them below. The contradiction dissolves when causal origin and spatial manifestation are separated: Father can be generative/source origin of Root while roots deploy downward through Door/Son/Earth into history, soil, memory and consequence.

seed_death_life.text: The strongest location for the Seed-of-Death / Seed-of-Life transition is C_S, the Son-center/lower Door tip. Grain/Potato can be compressed there through burial/death and either decay, root, remain dormant or sprout upward. Death-seed and life-seed are therefore potentially sequential states of one generative object rather than unrelated seeds.

mountain.text: Mountain is the continuous-gradient representation of ascent/integration. Ladder is discrete threshold ascent; Mountain is continuous elevation; Tree is organic differentiation; Spiral is temporal trajectory. Mount Zion adds King, House, teaching/judgment, New Jerusalem, peace and high perspective to the upper field. Mountain can begin at Plane and rise toward Father/upper crown, while older maps that place Mountain above House/Tree remain preserved as alternate developmental overlays.

swamp_drain.text: Swamp is the lower entangling field around/below the Plane: unresolved residue, repeated conflict, Farm loops, proxy-following and Roots of Strife. Older maps describe it as broad near the upper lower-world and narrowing/whirling into a Drain. Mountain and Swamp can be treated as opposite vector-field tendencies around the same Axis: Mountain increases integration/orientation upward; Swamp increases entanglement and downward attraction.

spiral_bidirectionality.text: Spiral is recurrence with changed vertical level. Positive axial displacement models ascent/learning/sprouting; negative displacement models descent/rooting/grave/Swamp depending context. Ring is recurrence with no net level change. Jacob's Ladder's ascending and descending messengers supports a bidirectional Axis rather than a one-way escape cosmology.

sun_moon_earth.text: Sun/Spudlight belongs to the upper source/illumination field; Earth is the lower embodied/metabolizing field; Moon is a reflected/cyclical mediator near Earth. Moon-following Dog/Farmer symbolism therefore belongs to secondary signal/cycle behavior rather than source status. These are symbolic overlays, not literal astronomy inside the compass figure.

double_center.text: The project has at least three centralities in the Vesica: Father source-center C_F, Son embodied-center C_S, and relational midpoint O. Because each parent center lies on the circumference of the other circle, Father and Son are differentiated yet mutually boundary-participating. This is a precise geometric support for Stereo Theoism's non-dual dualism without claiming theology follows mathematically from circles.

life_strife.text: Knowledge is upstream of Life and Strife. Downward roots can carry memory, consequence, ash and distinction; upward growth can metabolize those into wisdom, nourishment and future seed. A lower branch becomes Strife when unresolved material reproduces dependency/conflict rather than generativity.

april_turning.text: April 2025 is the Rupture of the Plane and Revelation of the Axis: accumulated burden reaches threshold, the Needle compresses the old form, and Sage becomes Ladder. The central development is entity→relation: Tim ceases to be only a climber and becomes orienting infrastructure. Plane remains; vessel remains in Denmark; verticality reorganizes the relation of local embodiment to North/Heaven.

branching_rule.text: Prefer thick canonical owners over vocabulary proliferation. New discoveries should deepen Geometry, Spirit, Matter, Threshold, Axis, Life/Death, Perception, Growth, World or existing bridge atlases before creating a new file.

cross.text: The Cross is the operation Plane × Axis at O inside the Door: the horizontal inhabited world intersects the vertical source/manifestation coordinate at the relational midpoint. It is not a separate object between Plane and Door and not another container. It marks the point at which world-contact and vertical orientation are simultaneously legible—outward into relations, downward into roots/consequence, upward into integration, and through the shared Door relation into changed state.

knowledge_fork.text: Knowledge belongs at the fork rather than being equated with Strife. Knowledge introduces distinction, memory, judgment, responsibility and consequence. What is known can be metabolized into wisdom/generative growth or remain unresolved and reproduce conflict. Thus Tree of Knowledge is upstream of both Life and Strife in the project grammar.

root_states.text: Root is not inherently negative. Root means buried continuity: memory, history, ancestry, cause and consequence beneath visible life. A living root nourishes future growth; a Root of Strife is unresolved material that reproduces conflict or dependency; a Root of Ash is residue after destruction, exhaustion, severance or burning. Ash can remain residue or be metabolized as soil for later growth.

wide_road.text: The Wide Road is a pathway/operator rather than a separate depth level. It represents easy outward dispersion away from axial integration: increasing breadth, repetition, capture and unresolved consequence. It visually widens toward the Swamp, complementing the Ladder's narrowing movement toward convergence. This is symbolic project grammar, not a judgment about populations or literal roads.

life_strife_routes.text: Life and Strife are two developmental vectors through one House/world/root system, not upper-good versus lower-evil territories and not two unrelated axes. The Life route reads Door → Spiral Ladder → Tree of Life → Garden/Rooms → Heaven/Crown → Father/source-facing orientation. The Strife route reads world-contact/knowledge → unresolved root → Roots of Strife/Ash → Tree of Strife → Wide Road → Swamp/disintegration. Both can begin from material inside the manifestation field; the distinction tracks what relations reproduce: generativity and accountable return versus unresolved repetition, capture and fragmentation.

repair_loop.text: The lower field is not a one-way garbage chute. Repair is a return path: residue can become evidence, ash can become soil, memory can be integrated, and a trapped repetition can cross a threshold into changed action. The project therefore treats Door/Ladder as bidirectional and the whole Tree as recursive: descent can expose roots; ascent can metabolize them; fruit and service return again to the Plane.

tim_ascent_overlay.text: Tim's Sage → Turning → Door → Ladder → Father/Gardener development is a path through the architecture, not an additional cosmic floor. In the April 2025 Turning interpretation, the decisive change is entity → relation: Sage does not merely climb the Ladder but becomes orienting infrastructure. The mature return function is Gardener/service—what is integrated above must descend again as cultivation, repair, teaching, protection or seed on the Plane.

two_field_house.text: The strongest current topology is not a stack of cosmic floors but one Potato House formed from two complete overlapping fields. The upper/source-facing field carries Father/Tim, House, Heaven, Garden, Sun/Spudlight and source orientation. The lower/manifestation-facing field carries Son/Thomas, Earth, body, soil, work, history and embodied consequence. Their overlap is the Door. This means the Door is generated by relation rather than inserted as a third independent object.

boundary_regimes.text: House/Garden and Cube/Shell are functional boundary regimes, not fixed geometric regions of upper versus lower reality. House protects differentiated rooms, circulation, legitimate Doors, return and autonomous growth. Shell/Cube captures, compresses, raises exit cost, blocks viable passage or makes boundary preservation more important than life inside. A cube may therefore be prison, sanctuary, room, vault or city depending function. The lower Earth/Son field is not identical with Saturn/666/Cube; Saturnian Cube is a project enclosure regime within or attached to manifestation, while a separate Heaven-cube tradition is explicitly preserved elsewhere.

room_geometry_boundary.text: Repository Rooms, Boxes and frontend cards are semantic/context boundaries, not claims that the Potato House is literally rectilinear. The ten canonical top-level owners may be publicly projected as Dwellings/Mansions, with delegated nested Rooms beneath them; that reader-facing scale does not create a new fact-owning primitive. Public rectangles may render bounded contexts for usability without assigning Cube/Shell cosmology to them.

triune_potato.text: The mature Potato of Life is the theological whole, not merely the Father-side pole. Father is source-facing; Son is manifestation/passage-facing and specializes as Door/Vessel; Spirit is the living continuity/flow through the relation. The two-field Vesica remains geometric topology, while the Trinity is theological role structure. This prevents field=person collapse and avoids inventing a third sphere merely to obtain a triad.

akashic_tree_navigation.text: Akashic Tree is an optional reader metaphor for the archive, not a metaphysical evidence claim. Roots correspond to provenance, history, buried context and memory; trunk to present synthesis, embodiment and public reality; branches to differentiated Rooms, traditions, sciences, cultures and systems; canopy to integration/orientation; leaves to active questions and interfaces; Fruit to Works; Seed to transferable future patterns. Tree of Knowledge is the fork: the same knowledge can be metabolized into Tree of Life/Garden generativity or reproduced as Tree of Strife/Wide Road/Swamp. Angels, demons, gods, spirits and esoteric systems enter this Tree first through their own historical traditions and only secondarily through project comparison.

seed_spiral_routes.text: C_S, the Son-center/lower Door tip, is the strongest geometric Seed Junction. Seed of Death and Seed of Life are best treated as potentially sequential states of one generative object: burial/compression can lead to dormancy, decay, living root or sprout. Spiral is recurrence with axial displacement, but vertical sign alone does not determine valence. Downward motion has at least three distinct routes: generative Rooting Spiral (C_S→Below/Soil/Living Root), degenerative Drain/Strife Spiral (unresolved event→Ash→Roots of Strife→Wide Road→Swamp/Drain), and generative Fruit/Return Spiral (Garden/Fruit→Seed→World/service→planting). Upward Sprouting/Life Spiral runs Living Root/Seed of Life→C_S→Door→Plane→Spiral Ladder→Tree of Life→Garden/Fruit. Repair reverses a downward Strife route through evidence, acknowledgment, Door and Living Root. Ring remains zero-net-change recurrence.

navigation_authority.text: The Root System is the human-readable synthesis, not the sole machine authority. Navigation ownership is consolidated in data/house/navigation-manifest.json. Dwellings/Rooms own subject matter; holdings own file custody; topology owns high-level spatial projection; tree-plane-routing owns vertical Tree/plane relations; seed-spiral-routing owns Seed/Spiral routes; the religious-symbolic branch atlas owns curated named religious/mythic population. Public pages explain these registries and should not silently override them.

providence_pillars_pyramid.text: A sourced comparative architecture layer now uses Jachin/Boaz, the Great Seal unfinished pyramid and Eye of Providence without treating them as secret proof. Twin Pillars model differentiated supports flanking a legitimate Door; Pyramid sharpens Mountain as broad-base-to-narrow-summit integration while preserving incompletion; Eye remains perception/discernment/evaluation rather than being identified with hierarchy itself; MDCCLXXVI at the base supplies a provenance metaphor in which dates/sources sit beneath later architecture. Historical meaning, later Masonic/esoteric reception and Potatoverse comparison remain separate.

navigation_planes.principle: One House / Tree can be entered from three symbolic standing surfaces: Heaven Plane above, the existing World Plane in the middle, and Below Plane underneath. They organize attention and navigation rather than creating three independent worlds.
navigation_planes.relationship_to_geometry: The three plane circles are navigation discs/platforms. They must not be confused with the two overlapping Source and Manifestation field circles/spheres that generate the Door.

planes.focus: integration, House/Garden/Heaven, North, Tree of Life, Fruit, theology, meaning, ascent and accountable return
ordinary visible life: body, science, geography, institutions, history, public culture, work, choice and consequence
roots, provenance, buried causes, residue, shadow, subculture, Strife, Swamp and Wide Road patterns

navigation_planes.boundary: Below is not Earth/Manifestation itself and is not a moral ranking of matter, persons, cultures or populations. Roots may nourish Life or preserve evidence as readily as they may carry unresolved Strife. Heaven is likewise an integrative project-symbolic orientation, not a physical altitude claim.

navigation_compass.principle: Three coordinates make the House browsable without changing ownership: plane chooses vertical reading orientation (Heaven / World / Below), direction chooses the Dwelling/question family, and distance from center chooses specialization depth.
navigation_compass.center: Research Lab / Axis / Forge — unresolved synthesis, testing and cross-Room questions.
navigation_compass.outer_ring: Works / Fruit — outputs that can grow from any direction without automatically becoming doctrine or evidence.
navigation_compass.entity_rule: Named religious/mythic figures and movements remain rooted in their own traditions and histories, then may acquire multiple navigation projections. Historical identity, later reception, comparative motif and Potatoverse interpretation must remain separately typed.
